semiconductor_relevance: High — Shenyang Heyan Technology Co., Ltd specializes in semiconductor-dedicated equipment, particularly in wafer grinding and dicing, which are critical processes in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shenyang Heyan Technology Co., Ltd is a manufacturer focused on the R&D, production, and sales of semiconductor equipment, particularly precision wafer grinders and dicing saws. The company serves various industries including integrated circuits and optoelectronics, providing innovative solutions tailored to customer needs.
capabilities: JS series automatic dicing, inspection and sorting-in-one tapeless saw
Solutions for grinding, cutting, lamination, peeling, cleaning, and diagnostics
technical_expertise: grinding processing of hard brittle materials

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Shenyang and has established multiple sales and service centers across various cities in China.
